Choose lower-cost shipping: Free, Standard ($8), Expedited ($15), or Rush ($30).

Use HSA/FSA benefits:

Klarna requirements (if you consider it where available): US-issued debit/credit card, age 18+, US billing address, SMS-capable phone.
